title: A task that runs a repository's programs plans its threat checks
goal: The /kb-backlog skill's plan step says that a task whose code runs a program from or against a repository gets checks, each with a planted failure, for: files the tool reads on its own (response files, config files in the project or its parents), toolchain or SDK redirects the repository can set, PATH and current-directory program lookup (Windows included), and what the environment passes to the child; a test in test_kb_mcp or test_backlog holds the phrase. Answers the SP-fkyrld5h failure: the sprint review found three S1 holes in kbingest map (Directory.Build.rsp, global.json sdk.paths, cmd.exe current-directory lookup) that no item check covered.
